pages.transcription:
16. 4. 41

Dear Hanna & Manfred,
As Eva wrote you such a
long letter relating all what we have done
together in this holiday week, I can confine
myself to-day to a few lines. Besides, I
have to be short as Eva and I are just
leaving for the circus. We have been very
glad to have Eva with us and the only
difficult thing for me was every night
to choose whether to sleep in ~~uncle~~ Stefan's
or in Eva's room; both of which, I can be
pleased to say, wanted my company.
She is going back to Croton to-morrow
afternoon, and I believe she enjoyed her
stay with us. Very soon I shall send you
her photos which I hope will be good and
lively.
Well the circus is waiting and
I have to go. I shall write in a few days
and perhaps there will be a new letter
from you to be answered by that time.
Love to all
Lotte
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief von Lotte Zweig. Die Tinte ist dunkelblau/schwarz, gut lesbar.
